The original wave-1 worker survived the session break and was still running. The resume read the file set as untouched and dispatched a second worker, so two telemetry workers wrote T0-T3 concurrently. Both reported done. Leader re-verified after both stopped: one set of tests, no duplicate funcs, sqlc output correct, every cheap guard clean. No work lost. Lesson for resume: a dispatched-but-unreconciled wave may still be live - check for running agents before re-dispatching.
